_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: a straight line of numbers moved a row or a few columns; 2: a shape moved a few rows or columns; 3: a shape flipped like a mirror; 4: a five- or six-number shape, or squares of the table's numbers. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
